name: Askadeck Party Questions
description: App Store & Play Store screenshots for a party game, conversation starter or couples question app. Rounded Plus Jakarta Sans headlines on purple, coral red, light and dark artboards with a soft checker. Two slanted photo bands show a pizza night and a couple on a sofa, a lightning bolt crosses into an ice breaker card with emoji on an arc and 3D ice, a phone lists game modes above emoji mood chips, a date photo curves into the app icon, and a chat panel, app card and laurels close the set. Every part sits in named, editable layer groups.
